flags.sourceSentence: At the end of the initial term, and at the end of each term thereafter, your membership renews automatically for a further twelve (12) month term at the then-current rate.
flags.consequence: Your membership renews automatically for another full 12-month term at whatever rate is then current, and to stop it you must give written notice at the Member Services desk at least 3 days before the renewal date — a very short window that is easy to miss.

flags.sourceSentence: Notice delivered after that day takes effect at the end of the term that follows, and the dues for the intervening term remain payable in full.
flags.consequence: If your cancellation notice arrives even one day late, it does not take effect until the end of the following 12-month term, and you owe the full dues for that entire intervening term — roughly a year of membership you did not want.

flags.sourceSentence: A membership that has been suspended, frozen or placed on medical hold continues to renew on its original schedule.
flags.consequence: A suspended, frozen or medically held membership still renews on its original schedule, so you could be committed to another 12-month term and owe its dues for a membership you could not use.

flags.sourceSentence: Meridian may amend the Club Rules, the Schedule of Fees, the hours of operation, the class timetable and the terms of this Agreement at any time by posting the amended version at the club or on the Meridian website, and the amended version applies to you from the date it is posted.
flags.consequence: Meridian can change the Club Rules, the fee schedule, opening hours, the class timetable and the terms of this agreement itself at any time, and the changes bind you from the date they are posted — including fee increases and new obligations — with your continued use treated as acceptance.

flags.sourceSentence: Meridian’s total liability to you for any claim arising out of or relating to this Agreement, your membership or your use of any facility — whether the claim is framed in contract, in negligence or otherwise — will not exceed the total dues and fees you paid to Meridian in the twelve (12) months immediately before the event giving rise to the claim.
flags.consequence: Meridian's total liability to you for any claim — including negligence — is capped at the dues and fees you paid in the previous 12 months, and it is not liable at all for property loss or damage on the premises, including lockers, or for indirect or consequential losses such as lost income.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify, defend and hold harmless Meridian and its ofﬁcers, employees, instructors and contractors against any claim, demand, loss, liability or expense, including reasonable legal fees, that is brought by a third party and arises out of your use of the facilities, your conduct on club premises, the conduct of a guest you bring, or any service you provide to another member.
flags.consequence: You must pay Meridian's legal costs and any third-party claims arising from your use of the facilities, your conduct, your guests' conduct, or any service you provide to another member — an open-ended obligation — and Meridian chooses the lawyer and can block any settlement you might want to make.

flags.sourceSentence: Program enrolment renews on each anniversary of your Program start date at the then-current tuition.
flags.consequence: Program enrolment renews automatically each year at the then-current tuition, which may be higher than what you paid, and to stop it you must give written notice at least 90 days before the anniversary date — missing that window commits you to another year of tuition.

flags.sourceSentence: For twelve (12) months after your Program candidacy ends for any reason, you will not teach, coach or deliver group ﬁtness instruction or personal training, whether as an employee, as a contractor or on your own account, at any facility within ﬁfteen (15) miles of a Meridian location at which you taught or trained.
flags.consequence: For 12 months after your Program candidacy ends for any reason — including if Meridian ends it or you cannot afford the tuition — you cannot teach, coach or deliver fitness or personal training, as employee, contractor or on your own account, at any facility within 15 miles of any Meridian location where you taught or trained, and you cannot solicit Meridian members or candidates for outside instruction.

flags.sourceSentence: Any dispute, claim or controversy between you and Meridian arising out of or relating to this Agreement, your membership or the Program will be resolved by ﬁnal and binding arbitration administered by a nationally recognised arbitration provider under its consumer arbitration rules, and you and Meridian each waive any right to a trial by jury and any right to bring or participate in a class, collective or representative action.
flags.consequence: You give up the right to a jury trial and the right to bring or join a class, collective or representative action against Meridian; disputes go to a single arbitrator whose award is final. You can opt out by written notice within 30 days of first accepting the agreement, and opting out does not affect your membership or Program standing.

flags.sourceSentence: Meridian may adjust dues once in any twelve (12) month period by the greater of six percent (6%)  or the increase in the Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers over the preceding twelve months, on thirty (30) days notice to the email address on your account.
flags.consequence: Meridian can raise your dues once in any 12-month period by the greater of 6% or CPI on 30 days' email notice, and the increase takes effect whether or not you saw the email.

flags.sourceSentence: Dues not received within ten (10) days of the draw date incur the late charge set out in the Schedule of Fees then in effect, which is posted at the Member Services desk and on the Meridian website and forms part of this Agreement.
flags.consequence: The specific amounts of late charges, returned-payment charges, keycard replacement and account reinstatement charges are not in this document — they sit in a Schedule of Fees posted elsewhere — so you are agreeing to charges you cannot see here, and Meridian can revise that schedule by posting it.

flags.sourceSentence: Access is by keycard or through the application, and you are responsible for every entry made with your keycard or your account.
flags.consequence: You are responsible for every entry made with your keycard or account, so if your card or account is used by someone else you could face charges or Club Rules consequences for their entry.

flags.sourceSentence: You agree to keep the contact details, billing details and emergency contact on your account current, and to tell Member Services in writing of any change within ten (10) days.
flags.consequence: You must notify Member Services in writing of any change to your contact, billing or emergency contact details within 10 days, and a missed notice could leave official notices (such as dues increases or renewal terms) going to an outdated email address.

flags.sourceSentence: Where the Plot Holder gives notice, no refund is due, and the Plot Holder may harvest whatever is ready before the notice period runs out.
flags.consequence: If the plot holder ends the licence early, they lose the unused portion of the $45 season fee, up to the full amount if they leave early in the season.

flags.sourceSentence: Anything left after 15 December becomes the Association’s to keep or to clear.
flags.consequence: Anything the plot holder leaves on the plot after 15 December 2027 — canes, netting, frames or other items — becomes the association's property to keep or dispose of, with no compensation.

flags.sourceSentence: On an annual plan the deadline to cancel is the day that falls thirty (30) days before the anniversary of the date you first subscribed, and where no cancellation is received by that day the term extends by a further twelve (12) months at the annual fee then in effect.
flags.consequence: On an annual plan, missing the cancellation deadline commits the signer to another full twelve-month term at whatever the annual fee is at that time, with no fresh signature required.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify and hold Northwind harmless from any claim brought by a third party that relates to content you uploaded, exported or published through the service, including a claim that the content infringes a copyright, a trade mark or a right of privacy, and you will pay our reasonable legal costs of defending such a claim.
flags.consequence: The signer must pay Northwind's reasonable legal costs and cover any third-party claim connected to content they uploaded, exported or published — an obligation with no dollar cap that could exceed anything they paid for the service.

flags.sourceSentence: Any dispute between you and Northwind arising out of these terms or out of your use of the service will be settled by binding arbitration before a single arbitrator under the consumer rules of a recognised arbitration body, and you agree to bring any claim only in your individual capacity and not as a plaintiff or class member in any purported class, collective or representative proceeding.
flags.consequence: The signer gives up the right to sue in court or join a class action against Northwind; disputes go to a single arbitrator whose decision is final, with only small-claims court left as an alternative route.

flags.sourceSentence: We may revise the fee for any plan, and a revised fee applies to you from the start of the first Billing Period that begins more than thirty (30) days after we send notice of the revision to the email address on your account.
flags.consequence: Northwind can raise the subscription price at any time, and the higher fee applies automatically from the start of the first billing period beginning more than thirty days after an email notice — the signer's only way to avoid it is to cancel.

flags.sourceSentence: Where a payment is not collected on its due date, interest accrues on the unpaid amount at one and one half percent (1.5%) per month from the due date until payment is received, and an account suspended for non-payment is subject to the reactivation charge published in the Fee Schedule on the Northwind support site.
flags.consequence: A missed or failed payment accrues interest at 1.5% per month (18% a year) on the unpaid amount, and the signer must also pay a reactivation charge whose amount is set in a Fee Schedule on Northwind's support site, not in this document.

flags.sourceSentence: Your subscription continues from one Billing Period into the next without further action by either of us, and we bill the plan fee then in effect on the first day of each new Billing Period.
flags.consequence: The subscription renews automatically every billing period without any action from the signer, and the fee charged is whatever Northwind is then charging, which may be higher than the original price.

flags.sourceSentence: A cancellation made on or after the first day of a Billing Period takes effect at the end of that Billing Period, and the fee already collected for it is not refunded.
flags.consequence: If a cancellation lands on or after the first day of a billing period, the signer pays for that entire period and cannot get the money back even if they stop using the service immediately.

flags.sourceSentence: We may amend these terms, the pricing page and the Fee Schedule at any time, an amended version takes effect when we post it at northwindstudio.example/terms, and your continued use of the service after it is posted is your acceptance of the amended version.
flags.consequence: Northwind can change the terms, the pricing and the Fee Schedule at any time, and the signer is bound by the changes simply by continuing to use the service — including changes that increase cost or reduce rights, with no signature or explicit consent needed.

flags.sourceSentence: Northwind’s aggregate liability to you for every claim relating to the service, whether framed in contract, in tort, in warranty or otherwise — and including any claim arising from lost work, lost revenue or a failed export — will not exceed the amount you actually paid us under Section 2 for the Billing Period in which the claim arose.
flags.consequence: If the service fails — including losing the signer's work or a failed export — the most they can recover is the amount paid for the single billing period in which the problem arose, and for a monthly plan that could be a very small figure against substantial lost work.

flags.sourceSentence: You may not share your credentials with anyone else, and an account we believe is being used by more than one person may be suspended while we ask you about it.
flags.consequence: If Northwind suspends the account because it believes more than one person is using it, the signer loses access to the editor, asset library and exports while Northwind investigates, with no stated time limit or compensation.

flags.sourceSentence: For a period of twelve (12) months following the last day of your employment, whether that employment ends at your choice or at ours, you will not provide services that are the same as or substantially similar to those you provided to Ardent, whether as an employee, a consultant, a contractor, an adviser or a principal, to any business that develops, manufactures or sells a product within the Restricted Field as that term is defined in Exhibit B to this letter.
flags.consequence: For 12 months after employment ends, the signer cannot work in a similar role for any business in the 'Restricted Field' (defined in Exhibit B, which was not provided), and cannot solicit Ardent employees or approach Ardent customers, distributors or contract manufacturers they dealt with — limiting where they can work and earn a living after leaving.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify Ardent and hold it harmless against any claim, loss, liability or expense, including reasonable attorney fees, that arises out of a breach by you of Section 4 or Section 5 of this letter, or out of a claim by a former employer that your employment with Ardent breaches an obligation you owe to them.
flags.consequence: The signer must personally pay Ardent's claims, losses, liabilities and attorney fees arising from a breach of the confidentiality or post-termination sections, or from a former employer's claim that the new job violates an obligation owed to that former employer — an open-ended amount the signer cannot cap in advance.

flags.sourceSentence: You and Ardent each agree that any claim arising out of or relating to your employment, its terms, or its end, including any statutory claim, will be resolved by final and binding arbitration administered under the employment rules of a nationally recognised arbitration provider, on an individual basis only, and each of us waives any right to a jury trial and any right to participate in a class, collective or representative action.
flags.consequence: The signer gives up the right to go to court with a jury or to join a class, collective or representative action for any employment-related claim, including statutory claims; disputes go to individual binding arbitration instead.

flags.sourceSentence: Bonus awards are discretionary in amount and in whether they are made at all, and an award is paid only if you are employed on the payment date.
flags.consequence: The bonus is entirely discretionary — Ardent can decide both whether to pay anything and how much — and the signer receives nothing if not employed on the payment date, so a year of work could end with no bonus if the signer leaves (or is let go) just before payment.

flags.sourceSentence: If you resign or are terminated for cause within twelve (12) months of your start date, the full signing payment becomes repayable within thirty days of your last working day.
flags.consequence: If the signer resigns or is fired for cause within 12 months of the 4 May 2026 start date, the entire $15,000 signing payment must be repaid within 30 days of their last working day.

flags.sourceSentence: Ardent may introduce, withdraw, interpret or amend any policy, handbook provision, benefit plan or term of employment described in this letter at any time and without your agreement, and the version in force on the Ardent intranet governs from the date it is published there.
flags.consequence: Ardent can change, withdraw or interpret any policy, benefit or term of employment at any time without the signer's agreement, so pay-related benefits, policies and terms described in the offer could be altered after signing.

flags.sourceSentence: The Operator's total liability to the Occupant for any loss of or damage to stored property, however caused, including loss or damage caused by the Operator's own negligence, is limited to five thousand dollars ($5,000) unless the Occupant has declared a higher value on the Unit Schedule and paid the corresponding value protection fee.
flags.consequence: If the occupant does not keep full-value insurance on the stored property and produce evidence of it on request, they bear the entire risk of loss or damage to everything in the unit, and the Operator's liability is capped at $5,000 even where the Operator's own negligence caused the loss.

flags.sourceSentence: The Occupant will indemnify, defend and hold the Operator harmless from every claim, demand, loss, cost and expense, including reasonable attorney fees, brought by any person and arising out of the Occupant's use of the unit or the premises, the property stored in the unit, or the acts of anyone the Occupant allows on to the premises.
flags.consequence: The occupant must pay for the Operator's legal defense and any claims, demands, losses, costs and expenses — including attorney fees — arising from the occupier's use of the unit, the stored property, or the acts of anyone the occupant allows on the premises. This obligation is open-ended and not capped.

flags.sourceSentence: Where rent or any charge is unpaid, the Operator has a lien on all property stored in the unit and may deny the Occupant access, overlock the unit, and after the notice period the law requires, sell the contents and apply the proceeds to what is owed.
flags.consequence: If rent or any charge goes unpaid, the lease gives the Operator a lien over everything stored in the unit, lets the Operator deny access and overlock the unit, and lets the Operator sell the contents after the notice period the law requires and apply the proceeds to what is owed — the occupant could lose all stored property.

flags.sourceSentence: Rent not received by the sixth day of the month incurs the late charge shown in the Schedule of Charges posted in the ofﬁce and on the Harbour Road website, and each further notice the Operator is required to send about an unpaid balance incurs the administration charge shown in the same schedule.
flags.consequence: The occupant faces late charges and per-notice administration charges whose amounts are not stated in this agreement — they are set in a separate Schedule of Charges posted in the office and on a website, so the occupant cannot see the figures from this document alone, and the administration charge can repeat with each notice about an unpaid balance.

flags.sourceSentence: The Occupant is required to keep insurance on the stored property for its full value and to produce evidence of it on request.
flags.consequence: The occupant must keep insurance on the stored property for its full value and produce evidence of it on request; if they do not, they carry the entire risk of loss themselves.

flags.sourceSentence: Gate hours, the rules posted in the office, and the terms of this Agreement may be changed by the Operator on notice posted at the facility and sent to the Occupant's last known email address, and the changed version applies to the Occupant from the first day of the month after it is posted.
flags.consequence: The Operator can change the agreement's terms, the rules, and gate hours unilaterally by posting notice at the facility and emailing the occupant's last known address, with the changes taking effect from the first day of the following month — the occupant cannot refuse or negotiate the changes.

flags.sourceSentence: Rent already paid for the month in which the Occupant moves out is not refunded.
flags.consequence: The occupant loses rent for the month in which they move out, even if they leave early in that month — the money is not refunded or prorated.

flags.sourceSentence: After the initial term this Agreement continues on a month to month basis, each month renewing on the first day of the month without notice from either party, until it is ended as Section 8 describes.
flags.consequence: The agreement renews itself automatically every month without any fresh signature or confirmation, so it will not end on its own; the occupant must affirmatively give written notice at least ten days before the end of a month to stop it.

flags.sourceSentence: Service on a twelve month promotional plan renews for a further twelve month term at the end of the term then running, at the standard rate for the plan rather than at the promotional rate, unless you tell us to stop the renewal before the last day of the current term.
flags.consequence: A twelve-month promotional plan renews automatically for another twelve-month term at the standard rate rather than the promotional rate, so missing the notice deadline commits the signer to a further year at a higher, unstated rate.

flags.sourceSentence: Cancelling a promotional plan before the end of its term does not cancel a device instalment plan, and the unpaid instalment balance becomes due in full on your next bill.
flags.consequence: Cancelling a promotional plan early makes the entire unpaid device instalment balance due immediately on the next bill, an amount set in documents the signer has not supplied and potentially large.

flags.sourceSentence: You and Cascade agree that any dispute arising out of or relating to this Agreement, the service or any device will be resolved by individual binding arbitration administered by a nationally recognised arbitration provider under its consumer rules, and both of us give up the right to a jury trial and the right to bring or join a class, collective or representative action.
flags.consequence: The signer gives up the right to a jury trial and the right to bring or join a class, collective or representative action, so serious disputes must be pursued alone in individual binding arbitration.

flags.sourceSentence: Your bill includes a Regulatory Cost Recovery Charge and an Administrative Charge, neither of which is a tax or a charge required by any government, and Cascade may introduce, increase or remove either charge on notice given with the bill in which the change ﬁrst appears.
flags.consequence: The bill includes a Regulatory Cost Recovery Charge and an Administrative Charge that are not government-required, and Cascade can introduce, increase or remove either on notice given with the bill in which the change first appears, so these add-ons can grow with little warning.

flags.sourceSentence: An amount not paid by the due date shown on the bill incurs a late payment charge of the greater of five dollars ($5.00) or one and one half percent of the unpaid balance, applied each bill period until the balance is paid, and a restored line incurs the restoral charge shown in the Rate and Charge Guide.
flags.consequence: A late payment adds the greater of $5.00 or 1.5% of the unpaid balance each bill period until paid, so the charge compounds on a growing balance, and restoring a suspended line adds a further charge set in a guide the signer has not supplied.

flags.sourceSentence: Cascade may change any term of this Agreement, any charge, and any feature of your rate plan, and the change takes effect on the date stated in the notice we give you, which may be given on a bill, by message to your device, or by email.
flags.consequence: Cascade can change any term, charge or rate-plan feature on notice by bill, device message or email, and the signer's continued use accepts the change, so terms and prices could shift repeatedly during service.

flags.sourceSentence: Cascade’s entire liability to you for any claim relating to the service, a device, or this Agreement, whether the claim is made in contract, in negligence, in warranty or under any statute, is limited to the service charges applied to the affected line during the bill period in which the claim arose, and Cascade is not liable for lost profits, lost data, or any indirect or consequential loss.
flags.consequence: Cascade's total liability for any claim is capped at one bill period's service charges for the affected line, and it is not liable for lost profits, lost data, or indirect or consequential loss, so a serious service failure could leave the signer with minimal recovery.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify and hold Cascade harmless from any claim, loss or expense, including reasonable legal fees, arising out of your use of the service, out of anything sent from or stored on your device, out of the use of your line by anyone you allow to use it, and out of any charge incurred on your account.
flags.consequence: The signer must cover Cascade's claims, losses and legal fees arising from use of the service, anything sent or stored on the device, use of the line by anyone they allow, and any charge on the account, which is open-ended and includes other people's use of their line.

flags.sourceSentence: Data speeds on an unlimited plan may be reduced after you use the monthly priority allowance shown on your Service Summary, and reduced speeds continue until the next bill period starts.
flags.consequence: On an unlimited plan, data speeds are reduced after the monthly priority allowance is used, and the reduced speed lasts until the next bill period, so heavy use in a month means slower service for the rest of that cycle.

flags.sourceSentence: Service on a monthly plan has no fixed term and continues from bill period to bill period until cancelled.
flags.consequence: The monthly plan has no fixed end date and continues from bill period to bill period until cancelled, so it will not stop on its own and the signer must actively cancel to end it.

flags.sourceSentence: Charges accrue to the end of the bill period in which you cancel, and a part bill period is not prorated.
flags.consequence: Charges accrue to the end of the bill period in which the signer cancels and the final part bill period is not prorated, so the signer pays for up to a full billing cycle of service they will not use.

flags.sourceSentence: The Firm may end the Programme early for any reason on one week written notice.
flags.consequence: The Firm can end the twelve-week programme with only one week's notice, cutting the Analyst's expected stipend income short with little time to find replacement work or housing.

flags.sourceSentence: For six (6) months after the Programme ends, the Analyst will not accept an engagement, whether paid or unpaid and whether as an employee, a contractor or an intern, with any firm on the Restricted List issued to the Analyst in week one of the Programme, and will not approach any client of the Firm whose file the Analyst worked on.
flags.consequence: For six months after the programme ends, the Analyst cannot take any engagement, paid or unpaid, with any firm on the Restricted List, and cannot approach any client whose file they worked on, which could block a significant share of entry-level job options in the sector.

flags.sourceSentence: The Analyst will indemnify the Firm and hold it harmless against any claim, loss or expense, including reasonable legal costs, arising out of a breach by the Analyst of Section 4 or Section 5, or out of anything the Analyst publishes about the Firm or a client of the Firm.
flags.consequence: The Analyst must pay for any claim, loss or expense the Firm incurs, including legal costs, arising from a breach of the confidentiality or post-programme restrictions, or from anything the Analyst publishes about the Firm or its clients, with no cap on the amount.

flags.sourceSentence: Any dispute between the Analyst and the Firm arising out of the Programme or out of this Agreement will be resolved by final and binding arbitration on an individual basis, administered under the employment rules of a nationally recognised provider, and the Analyst gives up any right to a jury trial and any right to bring or join a class or collective action.
flags.consequence: The Analyst gives up the right to a jury trial and the right to bring or join a class or collective action, and must resolve any dispute through individual binding arbitration instead.

flags.sourceSentence: Where the Analyst takes the optional housing advance, it is repaid in six equal instalments deducted from the stipend, and any instalment not recovered within ten (10) days of its due date carries the late charge set out in the Programme Handbook until it is repaid in full.
flags.consequence: A late charge, in an amount set in the Programme Handbook (not shown in this document), is added to each housing-advance instalment not repaid within ten days of its due date, and it keeps accruing until the advance is repaid in full.

flags.sourceSentence: The Firm may amend the Programme Handbook, the assessment structure, the teaching schedule and the terms of this Agreement at any time by issuing a revised version to the Analyst by email, and the revised version applies from the date of that email.
flags.consequence: The Firm can change the Handbook, the assessments, the teaching schedule and even the terms of this agreement itself at any time, with the change taking effect from the date of an email, so the deal the Analyst signed can be altered without their agreement.

flags.sourceSentence: An item not returned within five working days is charged at the replacement cost shown in the Programme Handbook.
flags.consequence: The Analyst is charged the replacement cost of any issued item, in an amount set in the Programme Handbook (not shown in this document), if it is not returned within five working days of the last day of the programme.
